iti62:1.1: II.) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttam-arahatā ti me sutaṃ.
iti62:2.1: Tīṇi-māni bhikkhave indriyāni. Katamāni tīṇi? Anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ aññindriyaṃ aññātāvindriyaṃ, imāni kho bhikkhave tīṇi indriyānīti. Etamatthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetaṃ iti vuccati:
iti62:3.1: Sekhassa sikkhamānassa ujumaggānusārino | khayasmiṃ paṭhamaṃ ñāṇaṃ tato aññā anantarā ||
iti62:4.1: Tato aññā-vimuttassa ñāṇaṃ ve hoti tādino | akuppā me vimuttīti bhavasaṃyojanakkhayā ||
iti62:5.1: Sa ve indriyasampanno santo santipade rato | dhāreti antimaṃ dehaṃ jetvā māraṃ savāhanan-ti ||
iti62:6.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||3|| (Tik.
